## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Spirit Blossom Irelia. 1 file for all chromas.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Spirit Blossom Irelia

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX colors to every chroma, base remains the same. You need to own the chroma and choose it in champ select in order to use this mod.
